who: Mentors, and members applying to be one
overview: Being a mentor on ICR starts with an application that ICR reviews. Once approved, the **Mentor desk** is your workspace: requests, mentees, your calendar, what you offer, your hours and your earnings.

rules: A request lapses if nobody answers it in time; the app shows how many days are left.
Declining needs a short reason, which the person sees.
A paid listing needs your seller terms accepted and paid selling switched on; the **Storefront** card at the top shows both.
Your plan decides how many listings you can have.
**Pause** hides a listing without deleting it.
ICR keeps a fee from each paid sale and pays the rest to your bank account. The fee is lower on higher Mentor plans.

website: A mentee's payment for a paid offering, which is made in their browser.

menu.pages: My sessions · Search mentors · Mentor dashboard · Mentor offerings
